title: Ant only
subtitle: Internal plus full exterior. Same as CAS.

sections.body: Same as CAS. Ask customer for hot spots and ant trails. Internal + full exterior.

sections.heading: Products
rows: Cracks, crevices, power point cavities, behind/under furniture, kickboards. Window & door architrave gaps: key ant entry points.
Light dust behind/under furniture, under bottom drawer. Powder blower through weep holes into wall cavity & enclosed subfloor.
All skirting boards. High pressure, clean start/stop. No dripping.
Full exterior via pump sprayer off truck.

sections.heading: Key ant focus areas
rows: Look for gaps, get Astro in. Main ant entry point into the structure.
Remove cover, Astro into wall void, replace. Ants travel through wall cavities.
Pipe runs & penetrations are ant highways. Treat thoroughly.
Powder blower through weep holes. Ants nest in wall cavities.
Face & top. Major ant harborage. Priority exterior area.
Adjacent to structure: spray soil & pavers near building.
Spray along fence line adjacent to structure.

sections.heading: Exterior: all areas
sections.body: Pump sprayer off truck, Fipronil. All walls, weep holes, eaves, windows, doors, soil, garden beds, retaining walls, fence line, meter box, AC penetrations, deck/pergola.

sections.heading: Job complete when
items: All interior areas treated incl. architrave gaps & power points
Wall cavities dusted via weep holes
Untreated areas noted on job report
Customer briefed on re-entry & what to expect

items.a: Yes. Synthetic pyrethroids, plant-derived, low-tox. Less than supermarket fly spray. Targeted, not blanketed. Safe once dry, about an hour. [Mitch to confirm this wording]
Normal. Takes 2 to 3 weeks for full effect. Still active after 3 weeks? Call us, we'll come back and assess.
Exterior around 3 to 6 months depending on weather. We recommend every 6 to 12 months. [Mitch to confirm: the onboarding pack script says exterior about 3 months and interior about 6 months]
